name: Xtensa Architecture and ESP8266/ESP32 Loader
author: Kevin Romero (fork of Zack Orndorff's binja-xtensa)
description: Xtensa (LX106/LX6) architecture plugin with ESP8266 and ESP32 firmware image loaders
longdescription: Disassembles and lifts the Xtensa base ISA plus the Code Density, Windowed Register, Boolean, single-precision Floating-Point, MAC16 and synchronization options used by the ESP8266 (LX106) and ESP32 (LX6) cores. Provides CALL0 and windowed calling conventions (windowed is the default, matching ESP32 application code), lifts the windowed call/entry/return instructions for useful decompilation, and includes BinaryViews that auto-load ESP8266 (E9/EA) and ESP32 (extended-header) flash images at their correct load addresses. This is a fork of Zack Orndorff's binja-xtensa, extended for full ESP32 (Xtensa LX6) support.
